verdict.rationale: Several independent community reports say Grok Build's source was released publicly as open source: there is a public xai-org/grok-build GitHub repo, users reviewed the 1.3M-line Rust codebase, and forks appeared soon after release. That shows the source can be read and that some open terms apply. However, no first-party doc in the pack names the license or confirms its terms, and the community notes Issues and Discussions are disabled on the repo. Missing for 10: the specific open license named in first-party evidence, and official documentation of the source release and its terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Criticism of the open-sourced code: 182 top-level external dependencies and about 1.3 million lines of Rust
Issues and Discussions are disabled on the open-source grok-build GitHub repo
